source: Real MR images from a TCIA collection; tools/make_real_mr.py

real-mr-seq.label: Four real MR images of the same axial plane of a patient with a glioblastoma: T1, T1 after gadolinium, T2, and FLAIR, each with its repetition, echo, and inversion times
real-mr-seq.cap: Real images of a patient with a glioblastoma on a 3 T scanner (TrioTim), in one axial plane, resampled onto the same grid from four sequences of one session. Times are in ms. Each image is scaled to the 99.5th percentile of its own signal. Data: TCIA UPENN-GBM (CC BY 4.0).

views.label: Sequences
views.facts: The T1 images are inversion-prepared gradient-echo images, and the second one follows an injection of gadolinium (Omniscan). CSF is dark on T1 and FLAIR and bright on T2. The tumour rim enhances after gadolinium, and the surrounding oedema is bright on T2 and FLAIR. The T2 images are 3D fast spin-echo, so their TE is an effective value.
